note: Single source of truth for the shipped testbenches (T1 item 9). Graded against the PROPOSED spec rows (#2, not ratified) and DR-001 to DR-004. No bench output is a measurement; figures a bench prints are simulated. verification/testbench-inventory.json is generated from this file by sim/bench/gen_inventory.py.

unbenched_rows.reason: no TX AC/S-parameter deck for driver + pad exists yet
latch_regen measures regeneration, not duty/quadrature/jitter at the receiving buffer
statistical eye with sampler Monte Carlo (DR-002) not built; rx-latch-regen carries the latch record only
jitter-tolerance sweep needs the behavioural CDR model, not built
error-rate method entry point (PRBS-31 statistical eye) not built
PDK bondpad model is an empty placeholder; no extracted/EM pad model
no extracted ESD clamp model; no ESD claim is made

not_simulation_rows.R2: structural (netlist/RTL review); the digital top bench is listed under R2 as a functional check
not_simulation_rows.R14: committed model spec/channel/channel_model.py, not a simulation

benches.description: TX HBT chain (pre-driver, FFE line driver) into 100 ohm, FFE off and on: swing, rise/fall, collector and reverse-Vbe stress, supply current
benches.corner_set: per request: one HBT process corner x 3 supplies x 3 temperatures; six requests give the 54-point PVT-full set
benches.limitations: R4 uses an ideal 100 ohm load, not the R18 pad model (placeholder). R16 covers the TX supply current only; RX and clock-path current are not measured here. R5 is graded at FFE off/on; the 4-step code sweep is tx-mos-ffe-en

benches.description: FFE enable/bias MOS cell: post-cursor bias per 4 FFE codes
benches.corner_set: 5 MOS corners (tt/ff/ss/fs/sf) x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Bias cell only; the de-emphasis in dB follows from tx-link

benches.description: Final 2:1 CML mux (MOS cell): swing, edge time, supply current
benches.corner_set: 5 MOS corners (tt/ff/ss/fs/sf) x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Edge times are +-30 mV thresholds of the cell output, not the 20-80 % pad edge of R7
